## Question

A clear and concise description of your question.

## Context

Provide some context about what you're trying to accomplish or what led to this question.

## What I've Tried

Describe what you've already tried or researched:

- [ ] Checked the README
- [ ] Searched existing issues
- [ ] Looked at the documentation
- [ ] Tried different approaches
- [ ] Other: [describe]

## Environment Information

**Operating System:**
- [ ] Windows
- [ ] macOS
- [ ] Linux (specify distribution)

**Python Version:**
- [ ] 3.11
- [ ] 3.12

**SRT Translator Version:**
- Version: [e.g., 1.0.0]
- Installation method: [e.g., pip install, source, etc.]

## Additional Details

- **Error Messages:** If you're getting errors, include them here
- **Screenshots:** If applicable, add screenshots
- **Code Examples:** If you're writing code, include relevant snippets
- **Expected vs Actual:** What you expected vs what actually happened

## Related Resources

- **Documentation:** Links to relevant docs you've already checked
- **Issues:** Links to related issues you found
- **Stack Overflow:** Any relevant SO posts you found

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues to avoid duplicates
- [ ] I have provided clear context about my question
- [ ] I have described what I've already tried
- [ ] I have included relevant environment information
- [ ] This is not a bug report or feature request

**Note:** Questions help us understand how to improve our documentation and user experience. We'll do our best to help you find the answer or point you in the right direction.
